claimBoundary: Shared-runner average-time ratchet. The v3 decision authority preserves and content-binds the frozen v2 benchmark inventory and finite family thresholds, but treats a material regression as established only when the JMH point estimate minus its reported scoreError remains above the configured maximum. A passing regression decision is not evidence of stable performance when the measurement is marked LOW_PRECISION. The authority does not establish cross-hardware absolute performance or statistical significance beyond the recorded JMH uncertainty.
